text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I visited a shrine to pray with Mihono 
Bourbon, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Two bows, two claps, one bow: finished... 
Operation 'Shrine Visit' is complete."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I have reported this as the number of 
detected malfunctions has increased 
recently."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
According to an online article, this is 
supposed to cure slumps, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"No change in condition. ...It seems there 
was an error in the article's report."
Whoa there! Hold your horses, you two.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recognized Inari's voice command. Taking 
action. In other words, "Hold yer horses."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well! I came to say hi to the gods, 
and what interesting conversation do I 
overhear?"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You're lacking that stylish flair that's 
so important for a shrine visit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ringing the bell with gusto, clapping my 
hands... I voice my wish from deep within 
my chest.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
If you stand tall and show just how strong 
your wish is, the gods'll find it all the 
more worthwhile to grant!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I see. It appears there was indeed an 
error in the information.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Shrine visit manual update complete. 
Executing Operation: "Even More Refined 
Worship."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to try visiting the 
shrine again—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"First... I ring the bell vigorously and 
clap my hands."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (CLANG-CLANG! CLAP-CLAP!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Here's wishing for a complete clean-up of 
all bad status effects!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Vitals confirmed stable. Master, cleanup 
was successful.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That was a pretty stylish way to pay 
your respects! I bet the gods loved it.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So this is the effect of "iki"... How 
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps thanks to our stylish shrine 
visit, Mihono Bourbon was back in top form 
in no time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rattle-clatter... CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: !? Dropping of the bell, confirmed...!

text_block_list.name: Shinto Priest
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Are you girls hurt!? I was just 
thinking it was about time to replace 
that, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Due to bad timing, the shrine bell was 
broken and they couldn't pray... Leaving 
them no choice but to head back to the 
academy."
